verdict.rationale: Google Cloud ships official MCP servers that operate on Cloud Run resources and deploy apps, plus MCP Toolbox for Databases, which connects Gemini CLI, Claude Code and other MCP clients to databases with NL2SQL. Together these let an AI-native user drive parts of the platform in natural language, but only through an external agent client and only for Cloud Run and databases. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface (console or CLI) for operating Google Cloud, coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases, and independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
